evidence.evidence_class: externally observed GitHub, public-network, and clean-clone state
observations: At the accepted commit these check runs completed with conclusion `success`: Quality, contracts, and packaging; Python 3.11; Python 3.12; Python 3.13; Compose configuration; Analyze python; Analyze javascript-typescript; Validate and package site; Deploy site.
Secret scanning, secret-scanning push protection, Dependabot security updates, private vulnerability reporting, and required web commit signoff were observed enabled.
`Dependency review` and `Commit signoff` run only on pull requests. Both were observed `success` on pull request #1; they do not run on a direct push and therefore do not appear at this commit.

A branch ruleset blocks deletion and non-fast-forward and requires nine status checks, with an `always` bypass for the repository-admin role so the bounded continuation controller can push reconciled ledgers to the default branch. The required checks therefore gate contributors and pull requests, not the maintainer's own pushes. The ruleset was observed acting on a real push, which reported `Bypassed rule violations`.
Establishes that the declared checks passed in GitHub's hosted environment at this commit. It does not establish source truth, independent validation, or production readiness.

evidence.evidence_class: externally observed GitHub, public-network, and clean-clone state
observations: GitHub Pages is configured with `build_type: workflow`. The `Pages` workflow completed `success` and the newest `github-pages` deployment is bound to the accepted commit.
All nine deployed assets were fetched unauthenticated and their SHA-256 digests match, byte for byte, a site built from an independent clean clone of the published remote at this commit.

Those exact deployed bytes were driven in Chromium. Seven published scenarios behaved as documented: valid -> PERMIT_SCOPED_NEGATIVE / ABSENT_WITHIN_SCOPE; incomplete -> REJECT_NEGATIVE / PARTIAL; stale -> REJECT_NEGATIVE / ABSENT_WITHIN_SCOPE; ambiguous -> REJECT_NEGATIVE / NOT_OBSERVED; conflicting -> REJECT_NEGATIVE / CONTRADICTORY; tampered -> REJECT_UNVERIFIED_INPUT; invalid -> REJECT_INVALID_INPUT.
The demonstration keeps input rejection distinct from a gate rejection, so a malformed or tampered request is never presented as an evidential rejection of the negative claim.
No console error, page error, or failed request was recorded, and no internal anchor was broken.
The run control is reachable by keyboard alone and activates with Enter.
At a 375px viewport the document scroll width equals the client width. An earlier 495px horizontal overflow caused by the decorative hero radial was fixed and re-measured.
Establishes deployed-artifact behaviour in one browser engine at two viewports. It is not a cross-browser test, an accessibility audit, or assistive-technology testing.

evidence.evidence_class: externally observed GitHub, public-network, and clean-clone state
observations: 27 labels; milestone #1 `v0.6.0 - MVP research candidate`; six bounded MVP issues (#2-#7) linked to that milestone and to acceptance identifiers, of which #2 and #3 are closed with their evidence recorded in comments.
Five issue forms with blank issues disabled, a pull-request template, CODEOWNERS, and Dependabot configuration with active update pull requests.
Discussions enabled with six categories; repository description, homepage, and ten topics set.

Secret scanning, secret-scanning push protection, Dependabot security updates, private vulnerability reporting, and required web commit signoff enabled. `secret_scanning_non_provider_patterns` and `secret_scanning_validity_checks` remain disabled; enabling them through the API did not take effect on this repository.

Branch ruleset `Default branch protection`: deletion, non-fast-forward, and required linear history blocked, nine required status checks, with an `always` bypass for the repository-admin role so the bounded controller can push reconciled ledgers. Required checks therefore gate contributors and pull requests, not the maintainer's own pushes.

Tag ruleset `Release tag immutability`: deletion, update, and non-fast-forward blocked on `refs/tags/v*` with no bypass actor, so an authorised release tag cannot be moved or removed without first changing the ruleset.

Public GitHub Project `Evidence-State I/O roadmap` at https://github.com/users/redxking/projects/9, reachable unauthenticated, listed under Repository projects on this repository's Projects tab, carrying issues #2-#7. Its README states that item state is work state, not validated evidence. It was created through the web interface because the maintainer's CLI token lacks the `project` scope; `gh project` and the GraphQL project fields remain unavailable from the command line.

Establishes that the governance, security, community, and project-management surfaces exist and are populated. It does not establish that any item is validated, that the rules were exercised against an adversary, or that a closed issue is evidence.

observations: Release `v0.6.0 - MVP research candidate` is published, not a draft, not a prerelease, and `isImmutable` is true.
The annotated tag object `a198f8253b0fb71c036b7a8ee1fadd236448bd55` points at commit `01805095b08aff5fe8951340a65c5dd56c5a3981`, which is the accepted commit and an ancestor of the default branch.
Six assets are attached: the wheel, the source distribution, SHA256SUMS, EVIDENCE-MANIFEST.json, SBOM.spdx.json, and LIMITATIONS.md.
Both distributions were downloaded unauthenticated and `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` reported OK for each.

EVIDENCE-MANIFEST.json binds tag `v0.6.0`, commit `01805095b08aff5fe8951340a65c5dd56c5a3981`, source tree `42f841f526cc20cd57ac35fc2e8c14cc419a7855`, version `0.6.0`, a clean tracked worktree, no runtime dependencies, and the two artifact digests and sizes. The recorded tree matches `git rev-parse <commit>^{tree}`.
The SPDX SBOM declares Apache-2.0, the exact purl, and a download location pinned to the accepted commit. The attached LIMITATIONS.md is byte-identical to `release/LIMITATIONS.md`.

The release workflow's own gate required every acceptance row other than MVP-ACC-025 to be PASS at the tagged commit, and verified stable SemVer, tag-to-package-version equality, and default-branch ancestry.

This row records the release binding only. The released package itself carries defect ESIO-DEF-001, recorded under MVP-ACC-009, MVP-ACC-013, and MVP-ACC-014: `evidence-state demo` does not work from an installed wheel outside a checkout. v0.6.0 is immutable and stands as published; the fix ships as a later version.
